basic_info.description: Beautifully remodeled Parkside Marina-style home, ideally located near Taraval Street MUNI lines, Stern Grove, Pine Lake Park, Lakeshore Plaza, Lake Merced, SF Zoo, and a variety of local shops and restaurants. This charming home features a spacious west-facing barrel-front living room with original fireplace, a formal dining room, and a newly renovated kitchen with a separate breakfast room or office and an enclosed side patio. The updated split bath includes a shower-over-tub, sink, and separate toilet room with an additional sink. Two generously sized rear bedrooms offer direct access to a large deck and deep backyard - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. An interior staircase leads to the expansive garage with room for two-car tandem parking and additional unwarranted living space, offering great potential for a second bath or expanded living area. The ground level also has a separate side entrance. Recent upgrades include brand-new furnace, water heater, new interior & exterior paint, newly refinished hardwood floors, and the kitchen & bath remodel. A rare opportunity in a prime location!
